description:
Child of op-mmep. New files: examples/distillation_sim_v1/physics/mod.rs, physics/column_config.rs.

physics/column_config.rs: the default 8-stage benzene/toluene plant config, built the same way op-6rhz's V&V test builds it (RigorousColumn::distillation(...).solver_input()) -- reflux ratio 2.0, reboiler heat-duty spec, feed 1 mol/s 50/50 saturated liquid at stage 4, total condenser, 30s tray hydraulic time constant, 50 mol drum/sump holdup. Needs op-mp9d (public benzene()/toluene()) landed first.

physics/mod.rs: DistillationPlant struct owning a DynamicColumn + current DynamicColumnState, a PlantCommands struct (reflux_ratio, reboiler_duty_watts, feed_flow_mol_s, feed_composition -- mirror HtgrPlant::step's dt+commands signature from examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/mod.rs:723), step(dt, commands) calling DynamicColumn::step_rk4, and write_snapshot(&self, s: &mut ColumnSnapshot) populating per-stage T/x/y/L/V plus distillate/bottoms/reboiler-duty/sim_time_s scalars from DynamicColumn::profiles(&state).

Mirror examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/mod.rs's HtgrPlant::{new,step,write_snapshot} pattern exactly -- same responsibilities, same call shape, different physics backend. Start the plant from DynamicColumn::startup_state (uniform-fill, deliberately far from steady) so the transient approach to steady state is visible on launch, exactly like the validated op-6rhz test does.

V&V (per workspace mandatory rule -- methodology AND measured results in the doc comment): a test that this plant's own startup transient reaches the same steady profile op-6rhz's test independently validates, within the same tolerances (0.05 K stage temperature, 1e-4 mole fraction, 1e-3 mol/s product split).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
DONE 2026-08-15. examples/distillation_sim_v1/physics/{mod.rs,column_config.rs} built.

DistillationPlant wraps DynamicColumn + DynamicColumnState, starts from a uniform-fill startup_state (visible relaxation on launch, mirroring op-6rhz's own test), and rebuilds the DynamicColumn on an operating-point change while carrying the differential state forward unchanged (DynamicColumn bakes reflux ratio/reboiler duty in at construction with no setter -- documented in the module doc why a rebuild-on-change is both necessary and physically correct).

V&V test plant_relaxes_to_the_validated_steady_profile: measured max stage-temperature deviation 5.16e-4 K, max liquid benzene-fraction deviation 3e-6, distillate 0.499999 mol/s, bottoms 0.500001 mol/s over a 100,000 s plant-time run -- inside the pass criteria (0.05 K / 1e-4 / 1e-3 mol/s) and tighter than op-6rhz's own recorded 4e-4 K / 9.3e-6 (this run integrates much longer, ~4300 s there vs 100,000 s here, so it sits closer to true steady). Also added same_commands_are_a_no_op_rebuild confirming the rebuild-on-change logic actually advances the state rather than silently no-op'ing.

Gates: cargo test --release -p outram-park-digital-twin-engine --example distillation_sim_v1 -> 3 passed, 0 failed (includes app-layer tests from op-81pb, built together).

title: distillation_sim_v1: physics layer -- DistillationPlant wrapping DynamicColumn
